Frequently asked questions

Does Parsley Health take insurance?

Yes — Parsley is the first functional medicine telehealth provider to accept insurance nationwide for our care membership. Parsley works with many major insurance plans to cover eligible medical costs. You can verify your coverage in less than 2 minutes.




Cash-pay options are available for $275/month or $2,750/year with a 12-month commitment. All Parsley programs are HSA/FSA eligible.




There is still a membership fee that covers access to your care team, coordination, and ongoing support.
